name: Midjourney
desc: Image generator known for output that looks designed
desc_zh: 以成片观感著称的图像生成产品
solves: Most generators return a technically correct image that looks generated. Midjourney's output has been good enough to use without a cleanup pass.
solves_zh: 多数生成器出的图技术上没错，一眼却看出是机器做的。Midjourney 的成品大多能直接用，省掉返工。
best_for: An image that has to look designed, not just illustrate the prompt.
best_for_zh: 当这张图要看起来是设计过的，而不只是把 prompt 画出来。
notes: 官网反爬未确认（403，www.midjourney.com 与 docs.midjourney.com 均返回 403）
